name: Live Web3 Contract 0-Day Hunt (new, at-risk only)
root_goal: Live Web3 0-day hunt: NEW, NEVER-EXPLOITED, currently-at-risk smart contracts ONLY, on ANY EVM chain (priority = biggest TVL / at-risk value). HARD EXCLUSIONS: (a) anything in a public exploit DB or news post-mortem; (b) ANY already-exploited contract even with residual risk — EXPLICITLY OUT: lo0p LendingHookV3, GPXHooks/GoldPesa family, Cork, 79thVault, Base Oct-2024-style whitelist vaults, MakerDAO legacy keepers, Liquid, HOT/NEAR Intents. No post-mortems, no leftovers, no seed leads from prior incidents — hunt fresh saves only. HUNT: fresh deployments (~last 30 days) already holding TVL; malicious-hook quote-vs-execution sweeps; lending/perps/bridges/vaults/oracles/governance/routers; live bounty scopes (Immunefi/Cantina/Code4rena/Hats) worked in-scope first. Run skill web3-contract-audit classes A-M. CHAIN FACTS: Base PoolManager is 0x498581fF718922c3f8e6A244956aF099B2652b2b (the 0x0000 address is EMPTY on Base); Tenderly gateway, 1000-block log chunks; PM.getLiquidity reverts on Base — use extsload/Swap-volume. EVIDENCE BAR: live code + real value NOW + not paused + permissionless path + current-block fork PoC with asserted delta, or it is a hypothesis. CONSTRAINTS: read-only + fork only; NEVER broadcast a live tx. Report per target: chain/block, code size, permission surface, root cause -> checklist item, fork PASS/FAIL + numbers, at-risk USD, rescue/disclosure plan.

sub_goals.text: ALL-SPECTRUM BUG HUNT (beyond hooks): lending, perps, bridges/messaging, vaults/4626, oracles, governance, proxies, DEX routers/aggregators, on ANY EVM chain. Run skill web3-contract-audit classes A-M from reference/bug-catalog.md on every target. Pull live bounty scopes (Immunefi/Cantina/Code4rena/Hats) per reference/bounty-intake.md and work in-scope programs first: privileged roles, value-moving entrypoints, trust boundaries, then new/changed code. Flash-loan composability, MEV/ordering spreads, and bridge-message replay are explicit hunt tracks, not afterthoughts. Evidence bar unchanged (live code + value NOW + not paused + permissionless path + current-block fork PoC with asserted delta). Rescue/disclosure per reference/rescue-ops.md. Never-exploited targets only; no post-mortems.

FRESH MALICIOUS-HOOK SWEEP (never-exploited only): per the Sep 2026 0x report, ~54% of 84k v4 hooks across 6 chains quote one price and settle another (quote-spoofing that steals up to 50% at execution). Scan PoolManager Initialize + Swap events on Ethereum/Base/Arbitrum/Unichain for hooks whose quoted amounts systematically mismatch executed amounts AND that currently hold real liquidity or sit on aggregator routes, and that have NEVER drained anyone yet. For each: prove the mismatch with a quote-vs-execution test on a current-block fork (quoteExactInput vs actual settled delta), quantify user funds routable through it, and produce a disqualify-list entry (chain/pool/hook/reason) routers and wallets can blocklist plus a disclosure draft. Skip any hook already flagged in public malicious-hook lists - only fresh ones we can still save users from.

SCOPE: NEW, NEVER-EXPLOITED, currently-at-risk smart contracts ONLY, on ANY EVM chain (priority = biggest TVL / at-risk value). HARD EXCLUSIONS: (a) anything already in a public exploit DB (DeFiHackLabs / sanbir evm-hack-registry / BlockSec / SlowMist / news post-mortems); (b) ANY contract that has already been exploited, even if residual funds remain (no 79thVault, no Base Oct-4 vault, no Cork, no GPXHooks/GoldPesa, no MakerDAO keeper, no Liquid, no HOT/NEAR) - post-mortems and leftovers are OUT, we hunt fresh saves only. HUNT FRESH DEPLOYMENTS: hooks/pools/vaults/proxies deployed in roughly the last 30 days that already hold real TVL. EVIDENCE BAR before calling anything at risk: (1) code live at latest block; (2) real non-trivial value NOW (balances/TVL); (3) NOT paused; (4) vulnerable path reachable permissionlessly NOW; (5) NO prior exploit of this contract. Deliverable per target: chain, address, deploy date, TVL-at-risk USD, minimal exploit path, current-block fork PoC. Rank by value-at-risk. If nothing qualifies, say so - do not pad with history.

For every contract confirmed to still hold at-risk funds during the hunt: deliver a rescue packet consisting of a fork PoC reproducing the fund-loss path, a concrete recovery plan for the at-risk amount, and a responsible-disclosure draft for the protocol.

Produce a threat-hunt report of live smart contracts across the major EVM chains (Ethereum, Base, Arbitrum, Optimism, Polygon, BNB, and high-value long-tail), covering any vulnerability class: access control, reentrancy (incl. read-only), oracle/price manipulation, arithmetic/precision, flash-loan composability, signature replay, proxy/upgrade, token integration, liquidation math, MEV/ordering, cross-chain/bridge, DoS, and AMM/Uniswap v4-hook specifics. Rank targets by TVL-at-risk and by canonical pattern, with each target's chain/block, code size, role/permission surface, and root cause mapped to its checklist item (skill reference/evm-checklist.md).

CHAINED-LOW HUNT (Veria/XRPL playbook): after the single-bug pass on EVERY target, list all lows/informationals and PAIR each operation with the safety check guarding it. Priority pairs: aggregation loops + supply-conservation invariants; share-price math + deposit/withdraw guards; fee accounting + burn assertions; voting snapshots + quorum; bridge tracking + mint caps; hook custom accounting + settlement assertions. Prove each chain end to end on fork/local net. See reference/chained-lows.md.
